Show a SINGLE short armored lower shin and complete foot, front three-quarter view with toe pointing slightly toward viewer-right, upright shin entering at top. Shape should be compact, about width:height 0.70, matching the old boot stance. Top shin is a modest overlap section for joining behind the body, no extra knee, no huge cuff, no new spikes. Entire foot and sole must be visible, generous genuinely transparent padding on all four sides, actual alpha transparent background. No second boot, no body, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no ornament unrelated to the references. Preserve complete toe contours. Production game sprite, not a realistic product photo.
